info.title: OctoEvidence.Cli
info.description: Evidence and traceability control plane for a tailorable full software lifecycle informed by ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207:2026.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207:2026-informed lifecycle evidence: identify, trace, validate, and gate.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Detect the repository and create or repair only its configuration and knowledge manifest.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --knowledge-root
options.description: Knowledge directory for a new setup, relative to the repository or absolute; defaults to knowledge-base.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Optional repository platform override; repeat for cross-platform repositories.

options.name: --source
options.description: Optional developer source-code glob override; repeat for multiple source/test roots.

options.name: --role
options.description: Lifecycle role or friendly alias used to tailor setup and the starter prompt. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report detection and planned writes without changing any file. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Validate repository configuration and every declared software lifecycle.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: portal
commands.description: Open the read-only reviewer portal for the current configured source repository.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port for the reviewer portal. [default: 5280]

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Start the portal without opening the default browser. [default: False]

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Install the agent operating contract and create role-specific lifecycle prompts.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Install lifecycle guidance, one selected specialist agent, and managed project instructions.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace modified OctoEvidence-owned skill and specialist-agent assets. [default: False]

options.name: --role
options.description: Lifecycle role or friendly alias; installs only that specialist agent. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --prune
options.description: Remove exact matching built-in unselected role agents and exact-hash allowlisted legacy schema copies. [default: False]

commands.name: roles
commands.description: List closed agent roles, the stages and knowledge collections each one writes, and required handoffs.

options.name: --explain
options.description: Show one role in full: stages, knowledge collections it writes, preconditions, and its ready prompt.

commands.name: prompt
commands.description: Create a ready-to-use prompt for one lifecycle role, operating mode, and requested task.

options.name: --role
options.description: Agent role from `octoevidence agent roles`. [default: lifecycle-coordinator]

options.name: --mode
options.description: bootstrap, delivery, knowledge, or audit. `knowledge` forbids repository edits and every lifecycle mutation. [default: bootstrap]

options.name: --task
options.description: The concrete work this session must do; included verbatim in the prompt.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Existing lcy_<UUIDv7> the session must operate inside rather than create.

commands.name: id
commands.description: Generate immutable time-ordered UUIDv7 identities; aliases and paths stay mutable metadata.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Generate one or more typed lifecycle identities.

options.name: --count
options.description: Number of identities to generate (1-100). [default: 1]

arguments.name: KIND
arguments.description: Entity kind: repository, knowledge, system, software-lifecycle, outcome, source, observation, document, need, requirement, architecture, design, component, change, integration, test-campaign, release, deployment, service, incident, retirement.

commands.name: knowledge
commands.description: Manage cited sources, extracted observations, typed lifecycle records, trace, and generated BRD/TRD views.

commands.name: source
commands.description: Register and refresh authoritative repository files.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Register one source file and bind its current bytes by SHA-256.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --kind
options.description: brd, trd, requirements, architecture, source-code, test, ci-cd, infrastructure, runbook, incident, or other. [default: other]

options.name: --title
options.description: Human-readable source title.

options.name: --revision
options.description: Immutable source revision; defaults to a content-addressed sha256 revision.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Re-hash one source and mark every dependent observation stale when its bytes changed.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --revision
options.description: New immutable source revision; defaults to a content-addressed sha256 revision.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List registered source files and current digests.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: observation
commands.description: Record atomic observed, inferred, proposed, or conflicting statements with citations.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Create one proposed observation for human review.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Owning lcy_<UUIDv7>.

options.name: --statement
options.description: One atomic statement.

options.name: --classification
options.description: observed, inferred, proposed, or conflicted. [default: observed]

options.name: --citation
options.description: Citation in src_<UUIDv7>@<locator> form; repeat for conflicts or corroboration.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Searchable classification tag.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List observations, including stale and conflicted statements.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

commands.name: record
commands.description: Create and trace canonical needs, requirements, architecture, design, components, changes, and downstream lifecycle records.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one proposed typed record in a new immutable-id folder.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Owning lcy_<UUIDv7>.

options.name: --title
options.description: Concise record title.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Complete, reviewable record statement.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Affected platform metadata; repeat as needed.

options.name: --observation
options.description: Supporting obs_<UUIDv7>; repeat as needed.

options.name: --trace
options.description: Typed edge in <relation>:<target-id> form; repeat as needed.

options.name: --property
options.description: Structured detail in <name>=<value> form, for example interface=POST /payments.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

arguments.name: KIND
arguments.description: Record kind: need, requirement, architecture, design, component, change, integration, test-campaign, release, deployment, service, incident, retirement.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List canonical typed records.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Optional record-kind filter.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Optional affected-platform filter; platform is record metadata, never a directory.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Append one typed trace edge and return the record to proposed review state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --relation
options.description: Closed trace relation.

options.name: --target
options.description: Existing target record id.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Reason for adding this trace.

commands.name: revise
commands.description: Revise one canonical record, preserve its id/history, and return it to proposed state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --title
options.description: Optional replacement title.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Optional replacement summary.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Optional complete replacement platform list.

options.name: --observation
options.description: Optional complete replacement observation list.

options.name: --trace
options.description: Optional complete replacement trace list in <relation>:<target-id> form.

options.name: --property
options.description: Property additions/replacements in <name>=<value> form.

options.name: --remove-property
options.description: Property name to remove; repeat as needed.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Required revision rationale.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Consolidate accepted release change-series into reviewable component baseline knowledge.

commands.name: consolidate
commands.description: Revise only the accepted component with one accepted release and its accepted impacting changes.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --component
options.description: Accepted cmp_<UUIDv7> to revise for human review.

options.name: --release
options.description: Accepted rel_<UUIDv7> that releases the selected changes.

options.name: --change
options.description: Accepted chg_<UUIDv7>; repeat as needed. Omit to derive released changes impacting the component.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Required reason for advancing the component baseline.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect one source, observation, typed record, or generated document.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Accept or reject a proposed observation, typed record, or generated document as an accountable human.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --status
options.description: accepted or rejected.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Required accountable human:<name>.

options.name: --rationale
options.description: Required review rationale.

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: obs_*, a typed lifecycle record id, or doc_*.

commands.name: document
commands.description: Generate immutable BRD or TRD views from canonical knowledge.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Create a new proposed generated-document folder.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --type
options.description: brd or trd.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Owning lcy_<UUIDv7>.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human actor creating the proposal. [default: agent:unassigned]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List generated BRD/TRD records and review state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lifecycle
options.description: Optional lcy_<UUIDv7> filter.

commands.name: lifecycle
commands.description: Create, inspect, validate, and gate the tailored ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207:2026 software lifecycle.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a machine-owned lifecycle manifest with immutable UUIDv7 identities.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --title
options.description: System or product title. Defaults to the alias.

options.name: --type
options.description: software-system, product, service, or software-element. [default: software-system]

options.name: --actor
options.description: Accountable actor that creates and initially owns the stages. [default: human:unassigned]

options.name: --delivery-model
options.description: internal-development, acquired, supplied, or mixed. [default: internal-development]

options.name: --acquirer
options.description: Accountable acquiring organization/party for acquired or mixed delivery.

options.name: --supplier
options.description: Accountable supplying organization/party for supplied or mixed delivery.

options.name: --criticality
options.description: Organization-defined criticality classification. [default: standard]

options.name: --stakeholder
options.description: Additional accountable stakeholder; repeat or pass multiple values.

options.name: --fact-review
options.description: optional (default) keeps the accountable decision on the record; required makes every cited observation need its own human decision first. [default: optional]

arguments.name: ALIAS
arguments.description: Human-readable lowercase system alias; identity is generated separately.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List software lifecycle manifests and validation state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Read and validate one lifecycle manifest.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: packet
commands.description: Generate lifecycles/<lcy_id>/reviews/current.md from current knowledge and lifecycle state.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Agent or human assembling the packet. [default: agent:lifecycle-coordinator]

commands.name: outcome
commands.description: Record a required lifecycle outcome and optionally append one typed trace artifact.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --stage
options.description: Lifecycle stage containing the outcome.

options.name: --code
options.description: Required outcome code shown in the lifecycle manifest.

options.name: --status
options.description: pending, achieved, or waived.

options.name: --artifact-id
options.description: Typed immutable artifact id, such as req_<UUIDv7>.

options.name: --artifact-type
options.description: Stage-specific artifact type returned by lifecycle inspect/gate.

options.name: --relation
options.description: Trace relation, such as defines, satisfies, verifies, or validates.

options.name: --repository
options.description: Optional originating rep_<UUIDv7> id.

options.name: --revision
options.description: Optional immutable originating repository revision.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Actor accountable for this outcome. Waiving requires an accountable human:<name>.

options.name: --waiver-rationale
options.description: Governed rationale required when status is waived.

commands.name: evidence
commands.description: Validate and attach a contextual evidence receipt to one outcome or continuous control.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --stage
options.description: Lifecycle stage; required with --outcome.

options.name: --outcome
options.description: Required outcome code to receive the evidence.

options.name: --control
options.description: Continuous control name to receive the evidence.

options.name: --receipt
options.description: Repository-relative YAML receipt under .octoevidence-evidence/.

commands.name: decision
commands.description: Import and verify a trusted, context-bound stage acceptance decision receipt.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --stage
options.description: Lifecycle stage approved by the signed decision.

options.name: --receipt
options.description: Repository-relative YAML receipt under .octoevidence-evidence/.

commands.name: control
commands.description: Set a continuous-control state and optionally append one typed supporting artifact.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --name
options.description: Configuration, information, decision, risk, measurement, or quality-assurance control name.

options.name: --state
options.description: planned, active, effective, or not-applicable.

options.name: --owner
options.description: Optional new accountable control owner.

commands.name: transition
commands.description: Append an iterative stage transition; accepted stages can be reopened for rework.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --stage
options.description: Lifecycle stage to transition.

options.name: --to
options.description: active, blocked, satisfied, accepted, or not-applicable.

options.name: --actor
options.description: Actor accountable for the transition. [default: human:unassigned]

options.name: --reason
options.description: Reason for blocking, tailoring, acceptance, or rework.

commands.name: gate
commands.description: Evaluate lifecycle outcomes through a target stage.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --stage
options.description: Target lifecycle stage. [default: validation]

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run the lifecycle and agent-enablement MCP server over standard input/output.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.
